# ledger_rates_status (Data Source)

The state of the locally cached currency-conversion rates: the provider, how fresh they are and the last refresh. Rates are provider-sourced data; this shows their provenance and freshness.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Provenance and freshness of the cached conversion rates.
data "ledger_rates_status" "rates" {}

output "rates_last_success" {
  value = data.ledger_rates_status.rates.last_success_at
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `as_of` (String) When this status was read.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether rate refreshing is enabled.
- `last_run` (Attributes) The last refresh run, or null. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--last_run))
- `last_success_at` (String) When a refresh last succeeded, or null.
- `rate_provider` (String) The rate provider.
- `refresh_after_seconds` (Number) How long a rate is considered recent.
- `refresh_available` (Boolean) Whether a refresh can be started.
- `refresh_interval_seconds` (Number) The scheduled refresh interval.
- `reporting_currency` (String) The reporting currency, or null.
- `source` (String) The source the rates come from.
- `stale_after_days` (Number) After this many days without a newer rate date a rate is stale.

<a id="nestedatt--last_run"></a>
### Nested Schema for `last_run`

Read-Only:

- `currencies_refreshed` (Number) How many currencies were refreshed.
- `error` (Attributes) The error, or null. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--last_run--error))
- `finished_at` (String) When it finished.
- `outcome` (String) succeeded, partial or failed.
- `started_at` (String) When it started.
- `trigger` (String) scheduled or manual.

<a id="nestedatt--last_run--error"></a>
### Nested Schema for `last_run.error`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) The error code.
- `kind` (String) unavailable, rate_limited, permanent or internal.
